home.heroTagline: Premium precious-metal collecting for those who arrive first.
home.heroBody: Choose your access level and join the first generation of Legacy Fan members: physical .999 silver and copper pieces, Mystery Boxes, a member number, a private community and priority on future collections.

prime.title: Prime Club
prime.tagline: Your gateway to the Legacy Fan universe.
prime.body: An annual membership to start your collection with .999 silver and copper Mystery Boxes, a member number, a private community, early access to selected pre-sales and exclusive benefits.
includes: Legacy Fan Club Member ID card
Private newsletter and exclusive YouTube channel
Points on purchases and upgrade raffles

prestige.title: Prestige Club
prestige.tagline: Premium access to the Legacy Fan universe.
prestige.body: Receive a 3 oz .999 silver inaugural piece, an exclusive 1 kg .999 colorized copper piece, silver and copper Mystery Boxes, nominal certification, Prestige packaging and superior priority on future collections.
includes: Nominal certification and premium packaging with QR
48–72 h early access and member pricing (5% always + 10% first year)
Vote on designs and hidden drops
Newsletter, exclusive YouTube and online events
Access to MS70/PF70 Slab and Founders Circle invitation

items.q: Does the reservation assign me a member number?
items.a: No. The member number is only assigned with full payment of the membership. The reservation amount is deducted from the total.

items.q: Can I choose or change club when I pay?
items.a: Yes. The reservation is generic; you choose or confirm your club (Prime or Prestige) when completing payment.
No. Legacy Fan products are collectible items. They do not constitute a financial product or any promise of future returns.
